svg.title: Two climbers on one rope, from dusk to sunrise
svg.desc: Animated scene: a leader and a second climber, joined by a taut rope, follow a teal route up a rock wall through dusk, night and sunrise. An aurora drifts, snow falls, a shooting star and birds cross the sky, headlamps glow, and the holds light up with captions. Both reach the summit flag, fist-bump, and the dog Sofie asks for a treat.

g.text: Study. Build. Meet people. Summit together.
